introduction: Missouri Temporary Assistance helps eligible families cover costs for their children. Most recipients also participate in Missouri Work Assistance.
description: Missouri Temporary Assistance helps eligible families cover costs for their children. Most recipients also participate in Missouri Work Assistance.

sections.who: Parents or guardians must meet child-age, residency, income, resource and other program conditions.
sections.get: Monthly cash benefits support children’s household needs. Employment services help families prepare for work.
sections.docs:
• Income, resources and child information.

sections.apply:
1. Watch orientation

    Start at Apply for Temporary Assistance.

  2. Apply and complete forms

    Use online or paper intake and submit all required companion forms.

  3. Respond to requests

    DSS contacts you if an interview is needed.
sections.after: Read the decision and work-program instructions; report changes.
